QuestInfo.name: Rushing to Rien
QuestInfo.0: Tru contacts you in a hurry. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: According to Tru, suspicious ships are approaching Rien! It seems like they're targeting the Seal Stone in Rien!
QuestInfo.2: As expected, the Black Wings came to Rien. Thankfully, you made in time to defend the Seal Stone. Though, it seems you weren't the only person to come to its rescue...

default.0: Wait, what are you doing here? Rien's in trouble right now!
